newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Notionnel to be capped by 128.78.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Notionnel to be capped by 128.78.

text.p: June French bond futures will trade in a narrow range on Tuesday, analysts said, with the Bund market providing more of a steer than domestic political news.
President Jacques Chirac took some uncertainty out of the market when he called a snap election on Monday, analysts said, and French bonds will continue to take their cue from Bunds.
"If we see the Bund market trading well above 100.62/64, the notionnel will trade up," one Paris-based broker said.
The notionnel contract will meet initial resistance at 128.56, and further resistance at 128.78, he added.
June notionnel futures were up 0.08 at 128.36 at 0831 GMT.
June French bonds reached a high of 128.54 earlier in Tuesday's session.
Bunds remained below the 100.62/64 pivotal level for the French market, making a high of 100.57 in early trading.
Support for the contract lies at 128.22, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said, a little below the 128.28 session low and Monday's 128.24 low.
A breach of the 128.22 level points to deeper retracement to 127.94 during this week, it said in a note to clients.
Norman Beauchamp, head of derivatives at Cooperative Bank in London, said he did not expect major underperformance or outperformance from here by the French market.
"Most of it's probably already in the market," he said, but added, "Short-term like the UK it's going to remain nervous."
